upstream_preservation.comparison: Remove only the marked EvoInquiry hook before comparing Codex skill content to the pinned baseline; unrelated retained upstream files checked byte-for-byte except explicitly documented metadata/docs/test/helper adaptations.

development_checks.behavior_exercises: Synthetic only; no randomized outcome comparison

CI_scope: GitHub Actions reruns Linux and macOS suites for a beta tag; actual run results are authoritative and are not pre-claimed here.
artifact_integrity: Git-tracked source archives and their SHA256SUMS are produced separately; release-manifest.json identifies their commit and inventory.
limits: Windows and credential-gated integration checks were not exercised by the local full suite.
Live providers, GPUs, image renderers, and complete research pipelines are not verified end to end.
Inherited workflows primarily target ML/AI and related engineering research; broad discipline coverage is untested.
No validation proves general scientific correctness or improved research outcomes.
Raw local session/validation records are excluded from public Git content.
